description: Shared by ExchangeContractTest.kt (Android) and ExchangeContractTests.swift (iOS). Bodies are raw response text, hand-written in the format of the live ECB files (eurofxref-hist-90d.xml / eurofxref-daily.xml as recorded on 5 November 2026), expectations are the parsed Ticker (-1 = Ticker.NO_DATA, change24hPercent null = must not be set). ECB euro reference rates straight from the ECB: newest daily value within 10 days of the newest ECB day, change against the previous ECB day; base other than EUR = quotient of the two euro rates rounded to 5 significant digits (EcbRates.cross).

cases.name: 90-day file: newest day is the price, change against the previous ECB day (weekend skipped)
